verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, a JavaScript SDK and a CLI for programmatic management of Paperspace resources, plus one-at-a-time actions such as creating, resizing or snapshotting a machine. Nothing shows a native bulk or batch capability that acts on many machines, notebooks or deployments at once. The API and CLI are only building blocks a user could script loops around, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
